handback.title: Nightly journeys on the sandbox file what breaks
handback.summary: Every night, Dokima plays the owner's main journeys on a sandbox repo, cleans up, and files what breaks.
handback.user_story: The owner learns each morning which of their usual journeys broke overnight, as a filed bug.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the nightly schedule fires, the play-through plays main's newest commit on the sandbox.
acceptance_criteria.words: A nightly workflow plays me through a few real journeys
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A schedule has one shape: it always fires on main.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a journey opens its issue, the test account's key opens it, not Dokima's app key.
acceptance_criteria.words: a test account standing in for me, with a token limited to that repo
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One key opens the issue; a missing key already fails the install.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the nightly run plays, a new issue goes from opened to merged, each step's card judged.

edge_cases.case: A card not redrawn fails its step and the run.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a stand-in plan asks the owner a question, that step passes only if the card shows Needs you.
acceptance_criteria.words: a question that stops for me

edge_cases.case: The card shows no Needs you after the question: the step fails.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the owner starts an approved split, that step passes only if the card lists every story.
acceptance_criteria.words: a split that files its stories

edge_cases.case: The card lists no stories: the step fails.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the journeys end, every issue and pull request they opened is closed.

edge_cases.case: A journey failed midway: clean-up still runs.
The gallery's own issue and pull request stay open.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the journeys end, every branch they pushed is deleted.

edge_cases.case: A merged pull request's branch is deleted too.
The gallery's own branch is kept.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a journey fails, one bug is filed on Dokima's repo, naming the journey and quoting what failed.
acceptance_criteria.words: A journey that fails files a bug like any other issue.

edge_cases.case: Every journey passes: no bug is filed.

non_functional.text: The nightly run starts only on its schedule or by hand, never on a pull request.
non_functional.why: The owner said it gates nothing and never shows on cards.
non_functional.words: it gates nothing and never shows on cards
non_functional.no_edge_cases: Triggers are a fixed list in one file.

test_changes.tests/test_playthrough.py::test_the_key_: Owner asks failed journeys to file bugs, so the run may write issues only.

raises.label: Stand-ins or real agents
raises.text: Should journeys run real agents that call a model? The plan keeps today's stand-ins, which cost nothing.
raises.evidence: `playthrough.yml` says stand-in agents call no model; the issue asks for real journeys.

raises.label: Repeat bugs
raises.text: A journey broken for days files a bug every night. Skip while one is open? The plan files nightly.
raises.evidence: The issue says a failing journey files a bug, and names no repeat case.

raises.label: Doubt: parked
raises.text: The issue says parked for later, yet autopilot started it. Plan it now? The plan assumes yes.
raises.evidence: The issue opens with Parked for later; autopilot started planning on 2026-10-20.
